name: Vanquishing Rage (general)
body:
You strike your chosen enemy with righteous fury.

Prerequisites: Rage class feature, vanquish foe class feature, base attack bonus +5

Benefit(s): When using your vanquish foe ability while raging, you add an additional +2 to your damage rolls against your chosen target in a round for each additional round of rage you choose to expend in that round, up to ¼ of your total.
